summary: Scilex Holding Co (via its indirect subsidiary ACEA Therapeutics) filed an 8-K disclosing a Stock Acquisition Agreement to sell 100% of ACEA Pharma to Phoenix Asia Holdings. Consideration is 100 million newly-issued Phoenix Asia ordinary shares at $10.00 each, implying a $1 billion value. Post-close, ACEA Thera will own ~82% of Phoenix Asia. Conditions include HSR antitrust clearance, Nasdaq reverse-merger/change-of-control review, and absence of material adverse effect. Expected close 2Q 2026. Watch: Nasdaq determination on reverse-merger rules; antitrust review timeline.
